tools.name: play_music
tools.description: Play music by song name, artist, album, or genre. Copy the request word for word. Use the playback tools for pausing, resuming, or skipping.

query.description: The song, artist, album, or genre, copied word for word.

tools.name: pause_media
tools.description: Pause the currently playing media. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: resume_media
tools.description: Resume the paused media playback. Starting something new is play_music. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: skip_track
tools.description: Skip to the next track. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: set_volume
tools.description: Set the speaker volume. This never pauses or skips anything.
